Faculty of Engineering and Information Technology
Chemical engineers change the world through use of their knowledge of chemistry, biology, computation and engineering to meet the needs of our technological society. Our highly ranked Department of Chemical Engineering is renowned for its impactful research, high quality teaching, impressive industry connections and excellent graduate outcomes.
Find out more about the department
Research at the Department of Chemical Engineering
Our research creates deep fundamental understanding to underpin innovative technologies addressing global sustainability, decarbonisation, and health challenges.
Study Chemical Engineering
Learn about our undergraduate pathway and graduate coursework and research options.
Engage with the Department of Chemical Engineering
Our industry partners provide platforms for translational research and employment pathways for our students.
A message from our Head of Department
Chemical engineering will be critical to addressing global challenges in sustainability and health. Our department is passionate about producing world-class engineers and novel research to help transform our society and planet.
Professor Kathryn Mumford
